description: The STREAM project publishes weather inputs for the Spanish pilot that tested a local energy-flexibility market. Zenodo lists one public CSV of about 16 KB under CC BY 4.0. The provider names Time, relative humidity, global horizontal irradiation and temperature. It says these variables support photovoltaic generation and flexibility forecasts, which in turn help anticipate low- and medium-voltage grid congestion. A modeller could pair this local weather series with the separately deposited pilot power and battery records when testing PV output or flexibility scenarios. The own page does not give the weather station, radiation and temperature units, measurement interval or exact coverage dates. It is site weather context, not a gridded climate projection. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this CSV. The contents were not downloaded, so sensor quality, timestamp alignment and missing observations remain unverified.
